My pick: Paneer Butter Masala with Butter Naan. Paneer in a creamy tomato-butter gravy. It's one of our bestsellers.

Can I add Paneer Butter Masala (₹260) to your cart?

rows.question: hey, what all can you help me with?
rows.reply: You can change or cancel an order until the kitchen starts cooking it. After that, a staff member will help you.

rows.question: is there any table free for 4 people?
rows.reply: Filtered drinking water is free. There's a water station near the entrance, and staff can bring a jug to your table.

rows.question: what's special today?
rows.reply: Today's (Monday) special is Hyderabadi Mutton Biryani (₹380). For vegetarians, it's Paneer Tikka Biryani (₹280). Would you like to know more?

rows.question: how much does this cost?
rows.reply:
Chicken 65 is ₹260. Deep-fried spicy chicken with curry leaves.
Can I add Chicken 65 (₹260) to your cart?

rows.question: any jain options?
rows.reply: Jain preparation (no onion, garlic or root vegetables) is possible for most gravies on request. Add it as a chef note. Bakes contain wheat and dairy; kulfi and desserts may contain nuts. Tell the chef about any allergy in the chef note. I've also asked a staff member to confirm which dishes the chef can make Jain today.

staffRequests.text: Jain preparation requested: please confirm suitable dishes

rows.question: i changed my mind, cancel the order
rows.reply: Done. Your order NDB-7087 hadn't started cooking yet, so I've cancelled it and told the kitchen. Nothing will be charged.

rows.question: how much longer for my food?
rows.reply: Most orders are ready in 15 to 25 minutes. Biryani and tandoor items take a little longer at peak hours.

rows.question: can you bring some napkins?
rows.reply: Certainly! I've sent your request for napkins to our service staff. It'll be with you shortly. Tell me your table number so they can find you quickly.

rows.question: where's the toilet?
rows.reply: The washrooms are at the back of the dining hall, past the bakery counter, on the left. Need someone to show you? Just say "call staff".

rows.question: i want to talk to the manager
rows.reply: Of course. I've asked a team member to come over. They'll be with you shortly. Tell me your table number so they can find you quickly.

staffRequests.text: Customer would like to speak to a staff member

rows.question: i have a nut allergy
rows.reply:
Thank you for telling me. These dishes list nuts on our menu, so please avoid them: Lemon Rice, Hot Badam Milk, Shahi Tukda, Rice Kheer, Kesar Pista Kulfi, Butterscotch Scoop, Banana Walnut Muffin.
I've added "ALLERGY: nuts" to your order for the chef and asked a staff member to confirm. Not every ingredient is listed on the menu and kitchens share equipment, so please wait for their confirmation before ordering.

staffRequests.text: Allergy (nuts): please confirm safe dishes with the chef

rows.question: the biryani is too salty
rows.reply: I'm sorry about that. I've informed our staff immediately, and they'll replace or reheat it for you.

staffRequests.text: Food quality: the biryani is too salty

rows.question: we've been waiting so long
rows.reply: I apologise for the delay. I've checked with the kitchen and alerted the staff. Tell me your table number so they can find you quickly.

staffRequests.text: Slow service: we've been waiting so long

rows.question: can we split it 4 ways
rows.reply: Your total is ₹399. Split 4 ways, that's ₹100 each (the last share adjusts by a rupee or two). Each person can pay by UPI, card or cash.

rows.question: do you take card?
rows.reply: Yes! You can pay by CARD. We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, and cash. I'll bring the bill here once your food is ready.
